name: City of Kannapolis Customer Service & Utility Billing
services: Water & sewer, stormwater, garbage & recycling, billed once a month
portal_tip: First time on the new portal (launched Dec 2025)? Existing customers keep their account number, username and email: choose “Forgot password” to set a new password. Autopay carried over automatically.

ways.detail: Pay, set up autopay, see usage and payment alerts
Automated line: 704-920-4400, or 704-920-4444 and choose option 1
City Hall parking lot, 401 Laureate Way. Takes cash.
Customer Service Center inside City Hall, 401 Laureate Way
City Hall parking lot: checks only
City of Kannapolis, PO Box 604072, Charlotte, NC 28260-4072

card_fee.free_option: Paying from a bank account (ACH/EFT) has no fee.

terms.text: All utility bills are due on receipt. Not receiving a bill doesn't excuse a late payment.

help.title: Behind on your bill?
help.text: Customer Service will set up a payment plan with you. Email your full name, phone number and account number to schedule a call.

help.title: High bill or a leak?
help.text: Check for leaks, then ask for a leak adjustment or a meter reread by calling 704-920-4444.

help.title: Start, stop or move service
help.text: Apply for new water/sewer service in the portal; call 704-920-4444 to close an account or for water/sewer taps.

help.title: Adjustment or credit request
help.text: For pool fills, leaks and other billing adjustments.
